name: skill-from-setup
description: Turns a one-time setup on one public place (a GitHub README, a registry listing, a directory entry, a profile page) into a reusable agent skill that any company can run. Audits real pages on that place first, splits objective rules from company-specific sources, writes the SKILL.md and its reference files, and tests the skill with a fresh agent. Use when asked to make a skill, playbook, or repeatable process for a platform, listing, or profile.
